compiler.sourceBookend: Exact frozen compiler manifest verified before and after full-web build and after all browser gates.

fullPlant.scope: Complete unchanged plant and original Modelica mass edit, original adaptive solver/tolerances and selected lockstep endpoints. Counters observe arguments/results without replacement. Instrumented timings are not the speed evidence.

lifetime.scope: Unmodified module/import/call arguments and results. Actual imported memory identity and immutable bases observed. Concurrent original/edited complete plants, reset and session free/fresh controls. Distinct observed bases do not independently establish complete region extents; allocator/Wasmi extent and alias controls are recorded separately. No timing or GC/physical-memory-release claim. Retained old functions are never called after their owning session is freed.

comparison.scope: Auto execution for both immutable compiler artifacts, same worker and baseline/candidate/candidate/baseline order. Same unchanged full plant, 90/20/90/10 Hz endpoint schedule, adaptive solver and tolerances. Advance timings include cold first30 frames and exclude preparation, snapshot extraction, sensors, rendering and all SLAM algorithms. Compiler artifacts contain multiple changes, so differences cannot be attributed to one patch. Shared-host load is not controlled by this probe.

limits: Physics timing excludes sensors, snapshot extraction, rendering and all SLAM algorithms; no 10x whole-pipeline claim.
Compiler artifacts include other generic emitter changes; the measured difference is not an isolated-patch causal benchmark.
Observed private bases are distinct; complete extent/latefault/reentrancy controls are separate native/Wasmi gates.
External functions were retained but not called after their owning sessions were freed; no browser GC or physical-memory-release assertion.
Browser private modules were captured, not byte-matched to the new native inventory.
Fixed20 MSL canary and application/compiler-pin integration are separate gates.
Full persistent correlated visual filter graph, image frontend, mapping and loop closure remain incomplete.
